description: Uploads a local GLB as a new draft scene, stored as it is (the "original" optimization preset). It has no thumbnail or baked shadow until it is first opened in the publisher. Publish it with publish_scene.

name.description: The scene name; defaults to the file name.

path.description: A GLB file on this machine; relative paths start at the project.

projectId.description: The project; defaults to the one vectreal init linked.

name: create_scene_from_file
title: Create a scene from a GLB
